csv_project_name: DB for FY27 Multiple Bldg Elevator Modernization
csv_scope_of_work: The Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota (the University ) is requesting Proposals to provide design-build services for elevator modernization in multiple buildings located throughout the Twin Cities campus (the Project ). The University of Minnesota seeks a team with proven experience in design-build delivery and elevator modernization work to provide the following: Design and Construction for: 1. Ecology Building, 02-438, cars T129 and T130. Construction may start anytime but elevators must be renovated in sequence 2. Yudof Hall, 01-189, T247 and T238. Construction must start after the Spring 2027 semester and be completed prior to Fall 2027 move in dates. 3. Sanford Hall, 01-028, cars T216 and T217. Construction must start after the Spring 2027 semester and be completed prior to Fall 2027 move in dates.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
